mia: ran a KV-cache comparison across regions/gpus. uploaded raw traces + summary: https://artifacts.redwood/kvcache/1813456789
omar: nice. what seq-length distribution did you use?
mia: 70% short (<=64), 20% mid (256), 10% long (2048). mixed request sizes to mimic product traffic.
jordan: which eviction/prefetch configs?
mia: LRU, generational, and size-aware eviction. prefetch modes: off, conservative (prefetch 32), aggressive (prefetch 128). paging threshold 85% GPU mem.
sasha: quick numbers? p50/p95/p99, hit rates?
mia: summary (H100 vs A100, generational + aggressive prefetch as example):
- H100: hit rate 85%, p50=4.5ms, p95=22ms, p99=110ms, throughput ~62K tokens/s
- A100: hit rate 79%, p50=6.2ms, p95=45ms, p99=820ms, throughput ~48K tokens/s

LRU vs generational (H100, same seq mix):
- LRU hit rate 78%, p95=30ms, p99=240ms
- Gen hit rate 85%, p95=22ms, p99=110ms

Prefetch effects (A100): prefetch reduced p50 by ~15% but increased p99 dramatically when memory pressure caused paging.
omar: so prefetch helps latency when no paging, but can cause paging thrash on A100 due to memory footprint.
mia: exactly. fused-kernel (optimized KV path) improved hit-path latency by ~10-15% vs baseline matmul kernels. caveat: when paging triggers, throughput collapses and fused kernel has no advantage.
jordan: any kernel selection differences by seqlen?
mia: fused path best for <=256 median seqlen. for heavy long-tail (>=1024) the memory amplification from prefetch + fused working set is risky unless capacity reserved.
sasha: actionable recommendation?
mia: prefer generational eviction + hot-pin window=4, conservative prefetch (32) for mixed traffic. enable aggressive prefetch only on H100/dedicated pools with >20% reserved headroom. pin recent prefixes for chat flows.
eva: can we canary gen-evict + conservative prefetch in prod?
mia: yes — planning a 2hr canary in us-west1 (h100) tomorrow 10:00 PT. will post rollout + alert thresholds.
deploy-bot: benchmark run 1813456789 finished: 18 configs, 1,200 traces, artifacts uploaded to https://artifacts.redwood/kvcache/1813456789
omar: add infra alerts: cache-hit-rate drop >5% and p99 > 300ms for 5m -> rollback canary.
mia: added alerts and will attach dashboard links in the canary doc.
sasha: solid. thanks for the thorough sweep. :thumbsup:
